measurement_scope: HTTP timings and outcomes are measured at this client. For deployed runs, no local CPU/RAM samples are used as a proxy for Render. Render resource metrics appear only when supplied through --render-metrics-csv.

cold_start.note: Confirmed only when the script waited at least 15 minutes and imported Render event/log evidence has a startup marker. Otherwise this is not a verified cold start.

stability.note: Compared first and second halves of completed requests; descriptive only, not a causal diagnosis.

endpoint_discovery.note: OpenAPI discovery is metadata only; discovered routes are not called. Authenticated/data-dependent routes need explicit endpoint selection and credentials, which this script does not collect.

safe_representative_choices./api/ping: lightweight process/HTTP health; Render health check route
safe_representative_choices./api/health: read-only database SELECT and pgvector operator plus embedding model loaded state
safe_representative_choices./api/openapi.json: metadata-only endpoint discovery; not a representative load endpoint

endpoint_coverage.fastembed: Health reports whether the FastEmbed model is loaded, but this app exposes no identified safe unauthenticated GET that executes embedding inference. Inference latency and CPU/RAM therefore remain unmeasured unless a separately authorized, non-destructive endpoint is supplied.
endpoint_coverage.authenticated_routes: OpenAPI-discovered routes are listed, not automatically called. Select only read-only routes and provide credentials through a separately reviewed mechanism; this script does not accept or print secrets.

sustainability_method: Not estimated: provide --max-rps for a rate ramp.

render_metrics.reason: No Render API credentials/service ID or CSV evidence was supplied.
render_metrics.how_to_collect: Supply --render-service-id srv-... and RENDER_API_KEY, or collect Dashboard Metrics plus Events/logs into the documented CSV. Render API time series resolution is at least 30 seconds; short phases may have no datapoints.

resource_measurements.reason: No Render CPU/RAM series supplied. Local machine metrics are never substituted.
resource_measurements.how_to_collect: Render Dashboard > backend service > Metrics: record CPU and memory for startup, idle, normal load, peak load, and sustained load. Events/logs provide restarts and startup markers. CSV headers: timestamp,phase,cpu_percent,cpu_cores,memory_mb,restart_count,event,message,source.

service_restart_detection.client_detection: The script records request failures, timeouts, and latency shifts, which can be consistent with a restart but cannot identify a restart conclusively.
service_restart_detection.check: Compare the run window with Render service Events and logs; include restart_count in supplied metrics CSV if recorded.

render_free_constraints.cpu: Render free web service plan is 0.1 CPU and 512 MB RAM; shared-plan CPU contention can affect latency. This is plan metadata, not measured usage.
render_free_constraints.spin_down: Free services spin down after 15 consecutive minutes without inbound traffic and commonly take about one minute to spin back up.
render_free_constraints.usage: 750 free instance hours per workspace/month; free services also count toward outbound bandwidth and build-pipeline included usage. Render may restart services; free web services are single-instance and not intended for production.
render_free_constraints.rps_limit: No guaranteed sustainable RPS is stated here; capacity is application-, dependency-, and traffic-dependent.

other_constraints_and_notes: Vercel functions have plan-dependent duration, memory, and invocation constraints; this backend benchmark does not measure Vercel frontend quotas.

EduNexus backend startup loads the FastEmbed embedding model, which can increase startup time and memory use. The configured Render health check uses /api/ping; /api/health additionally probes database/vector connectivity.
Client measurements cannot isolate frontend, proxy, database, model, or provider latency. Test endpoints that are safe and representative; GET-only requests are used.

baseline_http.note: PASS/FAIL here means the measured baseline requests returned expected responses; it does not assert a latency SLO.

cold_start.note: Confirmed only when the script waited at least 15 minutes and imported Render event/log evidence has a startup marker. Otherwise this is not a verified cold start.

startup_and_cold_start.startup_interval_definition: Render log timestamp from '[STARTUP] Loading embedding model...' to '[STARTUP] EduNexus AI ready.'; includes intervening app lifespan work and is not an isolated model-only duration.

highest_tested_clean_concurrency.note: Highest tested level with zero request failures only; not a capacity guarantee or universal RPS limit.

maximum_sustainable_rps.note: A bounded estimate across tested rate steps only; not a universal or guaranteed service limit.

workspace_usage_limits.note: Check current free instance-hours, bandwidth, and build-minute consumption in Render Dashboard billing/usage.

fastembed_inference.reason: No safe authorized inference endpoint was supplied.

status_semantics.PASS: Evidence was collected and meets a documented platform limit or explicit check rule.
status_semantics.WARNING: Evidence is incomplete or noteworthy; no universal latency/RPS threshold is implied.
status_semantics.FAIL: A measured error or documented resource limit breach occurred.
status_semantics.NOT MEASURED: Required source data or test run was absent; never treated as passing.

official_render_free_limits.status: DOCUMENTED PLATFORM LIMITS; ACCOUNT USAGE REMAINS ACCOUNT-SPECIFIC
official_render_free_limits.bandwidth_and_build_minutes: Count against workspace included usage; included amounts and current consumption must be checked in Render Dashboard. No universal bandwidth amount asserted.
other: Free services may be restarted by Render.
A Free web service is single-instance and cannot scale beyond one instance.
Free services have ephemeral filesystem and no persistent disk.
Free services are not recommended for production by Render.
Free web services can be suspended after unusually high service-initiated public traffic.
If using Render Free Postgres: 1 GB storage, 30-day expiry, no backups, and no managed connection pooling.

application_recommendations: No universal latency or RPS pass threshold is imposed. Set app-specific SLOs before interpreting performance as acceptable.
Verify FastEmbed startup memory and cold-start effect from Render logs/metrics. A model-loaded health field is not embedding-inference latency.
Use read-only authenticated GET routes only with explicit test credentials supplied through a secure process; this script does not accept credentials for EduNexus endpoints.
resource_measurement: Deployed service CPU/RAM come only from Render Public API metrics or explicitly imported Render evidence; local psutil/process metrics are never substituted for deployed targets.
